reason: All ten confirmed audit findings are implemented or pinned. A source-shaped ASCII ERE evaluator now owns recorder-glibc capture state, TTY More prompts preserve persistent stop state with prompt-scoped WIN_NOSTOP, and direct, installed, fresh, reset, sentinel, and contract evidence distinguishes every correction. Mutation evidence remains absent under the user's explicit work-session waiver.

boundary.startingEvent: A compiled startup regex evaluates a numeric reference through alternatives/repetition, a pending message and configured STOP consume More responses, or a reviewed parser/table/reset contract is exercised.
boundary.endingEvent: Recorder-glibc match selection and retained capture state agree, TTY stop/input/history state reaches the next input boundary in C order, and all ten audited contracts have discriminating evidence.
boundary.validInputs: ASCII recorder-glibc ERE with empty and repeated captures, configured MSGTYPE STOP with Escape/Space schedules and urgent prompt origins, negated bracket and unmatched-parenthesis forms, malformed warning numbers, sequential segments, ambiguous option prefixes, and combined autounlock display.
boundary.observables: Regex compile/match and installed action, message history/topline/stop state, queued input consumption, complete terminal screens/attributes/cursors, installed per-segment gp state, warning scanner destination, and PRNG calls.
boundary.exclusions: Non-ASCII locale matching, runtime autopickup object filtering, interactive MSGTYPE editing/serialization, USER_SOUNDS, non-exact-OVERRIDE custompline flags, and unrelated wrapped-urgent behavior remain named before-effect boundaries.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: Recorder-glibc regcomp/regexec through sys/share/posixregex.c, options.c msgtype_type/msgtype_parse_add, pline.c vpline, topl.c update_topl/more, wintty.c tty_putstr/tty_display_nhwindow, cfgfiles.c get_uchars, and lock/autounlock tables.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: Capture/reference sites, repetition/alternative structure, WIN_STOP/WIN_NOSTOP/TOPLINE states, MSGTYPE_NAMES, unlocktypes bits, config statement dispatch, and per-segment startup installation define the candidate families.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: Five finders traced the complete accumulated range and two adjudicators reconciled exact glibc probes and TTY prompt schedules; all eleven deduplicated candidates resolved to these ten findings or one rejected urgent-STOP claim.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: The review inspected js/posixregex.js, js/tty_message.js, js/options.js, js/jsmain.js, input/terminal state, fresh runners/oracles, and focused warning/MSGTYPE/autounlock tests.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: This checklist is exhaustive for the ten confirmed findings at review frontier e99227d and retains every adjudicated exclusion and rejection.

entries.candidate: Same-reference recovery preserves valid same-start capture-participating paths
entries.reachability: A rejected ECMAScript candidate can omit a referenced group while another path at the same start and same reference site participates.
entries.effects: Every recorder-glibc-valid match remains selectable without admitting nonparticipation false positives.
entries.evidence: The reference-aware ERE tree enumerates each alternative as a distinct capture-range state at the same input position, and a reference rejects only states where its group is undefined. Focused and direct-libc cases match (|())\2 on empty/nonempty text and ^((a)|b)*\2 on aab while rejecting the nonparticipation controls; the 26-case fresh matrix installs the empty-reference rule and suppresses the live welcome message.
entries.remaining: None within the named ASCII recorder-glibc boundary.

entries.candidate: Quantified subgroups retain glibc's last participating capture value
entries.reachability: A subgroup can participate in one repetition and be absent in a later repetition before its backreference.
entries.effects: The backreference consumes the last participating value until the subgroup participates again.
entries.evidence: Alternative states copy captures only when a group participates, so a b repetition retains group 2 from the earlier a; later participating a/c repetitions overwrite that range. Focused and direct-libc cases match ^((a)|b)*\2$ on aba and ^((a|c)|b)*\2$ on abcc while rejecting controls. The fresh matrix installs ^Hello ((a)|b)*\2, for a hero named aba and matches all screens, cursors, and PRNG calls.
entries.remaining: None within the named ASCII recorder-glibc boundary.

entries.candidate: A non-Escape STOP dismissal preserves an existing persistent stop
entries.reachability: A non-fitting prior message is dismissed with Escape, then the configured STOP message's explicit prompt is dismissed with Space before another input boundary.
entries.effects: Two prompts consume exactly Escape then Space, existing stop remains set, and a following pre-input ordinary message updates logical history without becoming visible.
entries.evidence: dismissPendingTtyMessage snapshots WIN_STOP across xwaitforspace, makes a non-Escape response monotonic, and receives preventEscapeStop only for More prompts reached inside urgent tty_putstr. Focused tests observe exactly prior Escape then explicit STOP Space, both prompt rows/cursors, retained sentinel input, invisible follow-up with updated history, stopped-at-entry suppression, urgent internal-prompt Escape, and urgent explicit-STOP Escape. A fresh debug-startup case reproduces the two-key Escape/Space schedule through the next input boundary in the 26-case exact matrix.
entries.remaining: None; unrelated wrapped-urgent consumers remain excluded.

entries.candidate: Negated POSIX bracket classes have semantic match evidence
entries.reachability: Valid startup patterns can negate a bracket containing a POSIX class.
entries.effects: A non-digit matches ^[^[:digit:]]$ while a digit does not.
entries.evidence: The focused semantic test and direct C oracle both prove ^[^[:digit:]]$ matches a and rejects 7.

entries.candidate: Unmatched close parenthesis is literal-match tested
entries.reachability: Recorder glibc accepts unmatched ) as an ordinary ERE character.
entries.evidence: The focused semantic test and direct C oracle both prove ^)$ matches ) and rejects the empty string.

entries.candidate: Malformed warning-number scanning discards the in-progress number
entries.reachability: get_uchars sees valid completed bytes followed by digits and an invalid byte before whitespace/NUL.
entries.effects: Count and completed prefix are returned; the destination slot for the partial number stays unchanged.
entries.evidence: The direct get_uchars test starts with [7,8,99,10,11,12], scans 65 66x, and proves count 1, stored 65, unchanged partial slot 8 and sentinel 99, plus the one syntax diagnostic. The cnf_line_WARNINGS test continues to assert only the initialized prefix.

entries.candidate: MSGTYPE state resets between sequential runSegment calls
entries.reachability: One segment installs hide-all and the next segment in the same JS process has no MSGTYPE directive.
entries.owner: js/jsmain.js NethackGame.start() with a focused runSegment integration test
entries.effects: The second gp.plinemsg_types is null and ordinary startup output remains visible/stored.
entries.evidence: One focused test awaits two sequential runSegment calls in the same process: hide-all installs a non-null list in the first game, then an rc with no MSGTYPE installs null and stores the visible Velkommen Shown startup message in _ttyPreviousMessage and _ttyToplines.

entries.candidate: MSGTYPE_NAMES source order is documented as prefix behavior
entries.reachability: msgtype_parse_add accepts the first table entry matching an abbreviated action.
entries.effects: s remains show before stop and n remains noshow before norep.
entries.evidence: The comment beside MSGTYPE_NAMES states that first prefix match is behavioral and names show-before-stop for s and noshow-before-norep for n; the existing focused prefix test pins both outcomes.

entries.reachability: The optionsfull getter maps each table index to 1 shifted by that index.
entries.evidence: The comment beside unlocktypes states optfn_autounlock's 1U << index mapping and names UNTRAP/APPLY_KEY/KICK/FORCE as bits 1/2/4/8; existing parser, optionsfull, and combined live-consumer tests pin the order.

entries.candidate: versinfo comment names the remaining same-field fallback exactly
entries.reachability: The compound options getter retains requireParsedNumber only for versinfo among value-less same-field fallbacks.
entries.effects: Future ports preserve the fail-closed type guard for the correct remaining row.
entries.evidence: The OPTION_VALUE_HANDLERS comment now names versinfo as the remaining same-field value-required fallback and explains why its handler retains requireParsedNumber; existing missing-value and raw-field tests pin the guard.

sourceReview: Every audited branch was retraced through sys/share/posixregex.c and the recorder's glibc regcomp/regexec ABI, options.c MSGTYPE lookup and tables, pline.c vpline/urgent display order, topl.c update_topl/more, wintty.c urgent flag lifetime and display, cfgfiles.c get_uchars, and per-segment jsmain installation. The production consumers execute through installed startup state and live TTY waits. Focused state tests, 87 direct libc regex comparisons, five vpline oracle comparisons, and the 26-segment fresh C/JS matrix cover capture choices, retention, termination, diagnostics, input schedules, history, complete screens/cursors, and PRNG order. The broad non-mutation population passed 4,729 assertions with mutation test files excluded; all generated/static/duplicate checks passed; development remained 11/33 sessions with 1,988 screens, 133,574 PRNG calls, and 2,007 cursors matched. Named exclusions stop before effect. Mutation commands remain waived for this work session.
